answer: The sable register is checked at draw time, canyon lists the eligible set, and wharf seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 38 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 38 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 5 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
